title: Han Solo
subtitle: Worth the Risk
text: Action [Exhaust]: Play a unit from your hand. It costs 1 resource less. Deal 2 damage to it.
deployBox: Action: Play a unit from your hand. It costs 1 resource less. Deal 2 damage to it.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
The ability on Han’s unit side cannot be used as an action if you choose not to play a unit, as it would not change the game state.
When using Han’s ability to play a unit, 2 damage is dealt to the played unit before resolving any “When Played” abilities.
